description_en: This operation creates an application in CADT from an official or a private template. Before calling this operation, ensure that you understand the billing methods and pricing for the associated Alibaba Cloud products
description_zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解阿里云产品的收费方式和价格。基于CADT上官方模板或私有模板创建新的应用
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request.

This token must be client-generated, unique across requests, and contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the application.

The name must be unique. You can call the <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428266.html</props><props="intl">ListApplication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-listapplication)</props> operation to query the list of applications.

The name can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (`_`), and hyphens (`-`). It must be 2 to 128 characters long, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and not start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
输入应用名称。

应用名称需唯一，不能与其他应用名称重复，可以调用<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428266.html</props><props="intl">ListApplication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/bp-studio/latest/api-bpstudio-2021-09-31-listapplication)</props>获取应用列表。
长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）、或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. This must be the same as the region where the template was published. Otherwise, the system reverts to the default version of the template
parameters.help_zh: 区域ID需与模板已发布的 region 保持一致，否则会回退到 default 版本
parameters.name: area_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group.

<notice>

This parameter specifies the resource group for all resources in the application. Ensure that the resources you import belong to this resource group.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用所属资源组ID

<notice>此参数将影响所创应用中所有资源的资源组，请确保导入资源的资源组与之一致></notice>
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create the application asynchronously.

Asynchronous creation: The application ID is returned immediately, but the application's state is `Creating`. Before performing subsequent operations, you must wait for the state to change to `Modified`.

Synchronous creation: The application ID is returned only after the application is created.

Note: If an application template is large or has a large number of template variables, synchronous creation may time out. In this case, create the application asynchronously
parameters.help_zh:
是否异步创建应用

异步创建：立即返回应用ID，但是应用此时没有创建完成，应用状态为 Creating ，需要等待应用创建完成，状态变为 Modified 才可以进行后续的处理。

非异步创建：应用创建完成后返回应用ID

注：当应用模版很大，模版变量很多时，使用非异步创建可能会发生超时情况，此时需要采用异步创建
parameters.name: create_async

parameters.help_en: The instances to import. You can use this parameter to create an application in an existing Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
parameters.name: instances

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters for the application. For example, `enableMonitor` determines whether to automatically create a monitoring task in Cloud Monitor, `enableReport` determines whether to generate reports, and setting `enableCompliance` to 1 enables compliance checks
parameters.help_zh: 应用相关配置参数，例如：enableMonitor 代表是否自动创建云监控; enableReport 代表是否生成相关报告,enableCompliance设置为1代表开启合规检查
parameters.name: configuration

parameters.help_en: The values of the template variables. If you omit this parameter, the variables' default values are used
parameters.help_zh: 对于带参数的模板，这个字段用于传递相关参数值，如果未传递，则使用默认值
parameters.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The key-value pairs for the process variables
parameters.name: process_variables
